items.title: Local LLM engine where a tool call cut by the token limit still parses
items.summary: When max_tokens runs out in the middle of a tool call, most engines return nothing usable. Xyntetik Runner closes the call to the smallest schema-legal document so the arguments still parse. The mechanism and the six-engine measurement.
items.interpretation: 这条信息说明模型能力、商业化速度或产品落地正在继续往前走，核心问题不再是“能不能做”，而是“谁先把能力变成持续收入”。
